note: Named sync jobs. Each pulls a source SOPIA defines into a dated, frozen snapshot inside cai, so cai works from a single download with nothing else reachable. Adding something to carry is an entry here, not a code change.

reflow-lines.summary: The line-breaking reflow implementation, carried into diction so its internal tooling reflows without requiring cai.
reflow-lines.why: diction ships independently and must not depend on cai -- inverting that is what the split exists to prevent. A hand-maintained second copy is the drift this suite spends its life closing. A DATED SNAPSHOT is neither: one canonical source, and a carried copy that states what it copied and when, so staleness is measured rather than guessed. Under the hood; no user reaches for it.
